digest.component_or_area: cross-subsystem config ownership and ambient read elimination (reconciler engine, store, snapshot, io, cli, commands, llm/workflow, mcp_server)
propositions: ~110 direct ambient config/credential reads (os.getenv, os.environ, load_config) exist below approved composition seams across reconciler, store, snapshot, io, cli, commands, llm/workflow, and mcp_server subsystems and must be either cut-to-seam or registered with exact path+symbol+rationale
Legacy exception set C1 must reach EMPTY with no path-glob exceptions and every declared config/credential name assigned a single owner

All S1-S6 behavioral suites must pass after each subsystem cutover and after legacy facade removal, with redacted operation snapshot fingerprints and provider-neutral outcomes unchanged except for explicitly recorded approved deltas

Legacy facades, migration switches, per-job ambient reloads, and migration exceptions must be removed only after their focused suites pass and with rollback capability retained down to the S1 snapshot-envelope compatibility floor
